# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_FAIL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps open beyond the prior day’s high/low and fails to reclaim VWAP within the first 15 minutes, the gap tends to fade as liquidity fills the imbalance. This edge exists because initial gap moves are often driven by imbalanced order flow that gets corrected by liquidity provision and arbitrage, causing a mean-reversion in the early session.

## Mechanism

Define gap up if open > prior day high + 0.2%; gap down if open < prior day low - 0.2%. After the opening bar (09:30‑09:45), if price is still above VWAP for a gap up (or below VWAP for a gap down) and the 5‑minute VWAP slope is opposite to gap direction (VWAP descending for gap up, ascending for gap down), enter opposite direction at the close of the 5‑minute bar where price crosses VWAP (i.e., for gap up, enter short when price closes below VWAP; for gap down, enter long when price closes above VWAP). Require volume on the crossing bar > 1.3× average 5‑min volume. Exit shape: Stop at the high/low of the opening bar (chart‑stop); target at 1× ATR or when price reaches the prior day’s close (named level) whichever is sooner. Regime hint: Works when VIX > 18 (elevated volatility) and during the first 30 minutes; avoid on days with major economic releases where gaps often persist.
